packageRules.description: Raise every manifest's floor in the same branch, so one package keeps one floor. Scoped to npm: on Docker tags and node-version it would turn 26 into 26.13.0.
One weekly PR. typescript and biome break checks on a minor, and a Redis minor bump is one-way, so each gets its own PR.
Redis data written by a newer minor will not load in an older one, so the bump cannot be rolled back.
A Postgres major needs a dump and restore of every self-hoster's db volume.
A Node major moves NODE_IMAGE, the @types/node override, engines and node-version in ci.yml together.
A pnpm bump also changes PNPM_VERSION and both checksums in the Dockerfile, which the hosted app cannot compute.
